answer: We model Sybil containment through spectral partition barriers, where a sparse cut acts as a multi-dimensional canyon isolating malicious identities. Applying personalized EigenTrust with a velvet decay factor over each terrace of the trust topology bounds the transition probability. By combining this topological attenuation with a cryptoeconomic slashing penalty c on staking collateral S and a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function, the expected attack utility U = pR - (1-p)cS becomes strictly negative, establishing a robust Nash equilibrium.
